limits.writeScope: Only PUBLISHER-CROSS-REVIEW.md/json in managed and ROOT release directories. Typecheck/lint may use their routine generated caches.
limits.causalLimit: Offline parser/control-flow/transport validation does not turn failed real matching into passing matching or establish production availability.
limits.concurrencyLimit: xmin atomically guards one observed complete target version. Existing RPC atomically guards expected review JSON and stage-key promotion, but does not transactionally guard the entire catalog or reject an externally introduced sibling. Immediate checks and readbacks require the serialized editorial publication window; concurrent external writes can be detected but not rolled back by this helper.
limits.proofLimit: Main harness substitutes only in-memory fs/transport and the deployment Git proof seam. Transport harness uses dummy env, mocked fetch and timer; it never loads real env files or makes HTTP calls. Final Git/deployed proof verification is source-reviewed, not falsely claimed executed against a future deployment.

remainingBeforeLive: Root must record actual final source-head full CI, merge/deployment exact proof, then fresh root-only preflight/live publication/worker refresh/read-only health and canary evidence.
